title: Mutant Research
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Germ

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: We need a long term solution for the mutant overpopulation. If we had a good amount of Mutant Remains we could better study them and find a way to keep them from overrunning Algernon.

Quest Reward: 2500 Gold

Return to: Soldier Germ in Algernon

Repeatable: Yes
